accepted.evidence: Printed p.129 section 2.3.27 explicitly segments the adjective with -ālo and distinguishes stem from affix. čhib-ālo cheeky is literally having a tongue; čik-ālo muddy is formed on čik mud. Link the adjective to its existing same-source nominal base; no reconstruction of the entire adjective as a direct Sanskrit reflex.
